custom_expected: The system should prompt the user to enable Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable (this is the setting formerly labelled "View and Manage AP/AR").
custom_preconds: Logged in as Owner; on the blank Create Role page
custom_steps:
1. Open the Create Custom Role page
  2. In the Invoicing and Payments area, enable the Delete checkbox while Manage AP/AR is OFF
title: Enabling "Invoicing & Payments → Delete" While "Manage AP/AR" Is OFF SHOULD Prompt the User to Enable AP/AR
